purpose: HUMAN-maintained sign-off ledger read by placement_gate.py. An entry in 'dismissed' tells the gate that a drawn cluster it would otherwise flag as UNPLACED (missing furniture) OR an un-clusterable merged REGION is actually NON-furniture (a door swing, wall hatching, dimension/boundary linework) — so the recurring 'is this drawn blob a piece?' question is answered ONCE and stops re-flagging on every regeneration. Matched by GEOMETRY (centre+size within a size-scaled tolerance), not the scipy cluster id (which renumbers). Only add an entry you have personally confirmed on the plan; deleting an entry re-opens the question and forces a re-gate.
